description_en: Call `QueryDomainByDomainName` to retrieve information about a domain name
description_zh: 调用QueryDomainByDomainName按域名查询域名信息
kebab_example: aliyun domain query-domain-by-domain-name --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --lang en --domain-name example.com --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDomainByDomainName

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message that is returned. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

DomainGroupId.description_en: The ID of the domain group. You can obtain the ID by calling the [QueryDomainGroupList]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.html） operation
DomainGroupId.description_zh: 域名分组ID，可使用查询域名分组的[QueryDomainGroupList]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.html）接口获取

DomainGroupName.description_en: The name of the domain group

DomainNameProxyService.description_en: Indicates whether privacy protection is enabled
DomainNameProxyService.description_zh: 是否已开启隐私保护状态

DomainNameVerificationStatus.description_en:
The status of the domain name review. Valid values:

NONAUDIT: Not reviewed.

SUCCEED: Successful.

FAILED: Failed.

AUDITING: In review
DomainNameVerificationStatus.description_zh:
命名审核状态。取值：
NONAUDIT：未认证。
SUCCEED： 成功。
FAILED：审核失败。
AUDITING：审核中

DomainStatus.description_en:
The status of the domain name. Valid values:

1: Renewal required.

2: Redemption required.

3: Active
DomainStatus.description_zh:
域名状态。取值：

1：急需续费。                                 
2：急需赎回。                                 
3：正常

DomainType.description_en:
The type of the domain name. Valid values:

New gTLD

gTLD

ccTLD
DomainType.description_zh:
域名类型。取值：

New gTLD。                                 
gTLD。                                 
ccTLD

EmailVerificationClientHold.description_en: Indicates whether the domain name has a `clientHold` status due to email verification failure

EmailVerificationStatus.description_en:
The email verification status. Valid values:

0: Not verified.

1: Verified
EmailVerificationStatus.description_zh:
邮箱是否已通过验证。取值：
0：没有通过验证。
1：已通过验证

ExpirationCurrDateDiff.description_en: The number of days until the expiration date
ExpirationCurrDateDiff.description_zh: 域名到期日和当前的时间的天数差值

ExpirationDate.description_en: The expiration date of the domain name

ExpirationDateLong.description_en: The timestamp of the expiration date

ExpirationDateStatus.description_en:
The expiration status of the domain name. Valid values:

1: The domain name has not expired.

2: The domain name has expired
ExpirationDateStatus.description_zh:
域名过期状态。取值：
1：域名未过期。
2：域名已过期。

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the domain name

Premium.description_en: Indicates whether the domain name is a premium domain

RealNameStatus.description_en:
The real-name verification status of the domain name. Valid values:

NONAUDIT: Not verified.

SUCCEED: Successful.

FAILED: Failed.

AUDITING: In review
RealNameStatus.description_zh:
域名实名认证状态。取值：
NONAUDIT：未实名认证。
SUCCEED：成功。
FAILED：审核失败。
AUDITING：审核中

RegistrantName.description_en: The name of the individual registrant or the contact person for an organization

RegistrantOrganization.description_en: The name of the registrant organization

RegistrantType.description_en:
The type of the registrant. Valid values:

1: Individual.

2: Enterprise
RegistrantType.description_zh:
域名注册联系人类型。取值：
1：个人。
2：企业

RegistrantUpdatingStatus.description_en:
The status of registrant information updates. Valid values:

PENDING: The registrant information is being updated.

NORMAL: No update is in progress
RegistrantUpdatingStatus.description_zh:
域名持有者修改状态。取值：
PENDING：域名持有者信息修改中。
NORMAL：正常

RegistrationDate.description_en: The registration date of the domain name

RegistrationDateLong.description_en: The timestamp of the registration date

Remark.description_en: The user-provided remark for the domain name

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

Tag.description_en: The tags attached to the domain name

TransferOutStatus.description_en:
The status of the domain transfer out. Valid values:

NORMAL: The domain name is not being transferred out.

PENDING: The domain name is being transferred out from HiChina
TransferOutStatus.description_zh:
域名转出状态。取值：
NORMAL：正常。
PENDING：正在转出万网

TransferProhibitionLock.description_en:
The status of the domain transfer lock. Valid values:

NONE_SETTING: Not set.

OPEN: Enabled.

CLOSE: Disabled
TransferProhibitionLock.description_zh:
域名转移锁状态。取值：
NONE_SETTING：未设置。
OPEN：已开启。
CLOSE：已关闭

UpdateProhibitionLock.description_en:
The status of the domain name security lock. Valid values:

NONE_SETTING: Not set.

OPEN: Enabled.

CLOSE: Disabled
UpdateProhibitionLock.description_zh:
域名安全锁状态。取值： 
NONE_SETTING：未设置。
OPEN：已开启。
CLOSE：已关闭。

UserId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

ZhRegistrantName.description_en: The name of the contact person in Chinese

ZhRegistrantOrganization.description_en: The name of the registrant in Chinese
